title: Lean SDP-uniqueness wiring for the atlas entries
html:
SDP uniqueness

What is certified: the abstract framework demonstration of T_w uniqueness at the empty-constraint SDP for a nucleus's strand count. The real per-nucleus SDP (with non-empty constraints from the mass formula and multi-term cost) is per-nucleus substantive open work.

Within that scope, each atlas entry has a corresponding SDP-uniqueness theorem. Take ^4He: with mass number A = 4 the strand count is n = 3A = 12, and the canonical T_w knot operator's uniqueness at the empty-constraint SDP demonstration level is certified by the single parameterised statement

\mathrm{UniqueOptimal}\bigl(T_w,\; H_{3A}(q)\bigr)

instantiated at 3A = 12. The same parameterised statement covers any nucleus once A (equivalently n = 3A) is fixed.
